_README: Conversion rules for 'Copy Studio-safe' in the Fusion Clipboard panel.
ResolveFX ship with DaVinci Resolve and do NOT exist in Fusion Studio, so a
preset using them comes up with missing tools there. These rules rewrite
them into native Fusion tools. Third-party OFX and Fuses are deliberately
left alone - install those in Studio and they resolve fine.
ANYTHING IN <<ANGLE BRACKETS>> IS UNVERIFIED AND BLOCKS THE RULE FROM
RUNNING. That is on purpose. A wrong target input name cannot be detected
from the text - Fusion silently accepts unknown inputs and pastes the node
at its defaults - so the only defence is capturing the real names first.
To fill them in: in Fusion, add the native tool, move EVERY control off its
default (Fusion only writes out non-default inputs), Ctrl+C, then click
'Learn Node' in the panel. Replace each <<placeholder>> with what the report
shows. Then calibrate the numbers by eye: build the ResolveFX node and the
converted native one side by side in Resolve and A/B them.
Transforms are named and implemented in Python, never expressions, so this
file can never execute code.
passthrough  - copy the value across
linear       - value * mul + add, optional clamp [low, high]
polar_to_xy  - angle + distance -> x, y. Calibrate angle_zero_deg,
angle_sign (+1 CCW / -1 CW) and distance_mul by MEASURING:
set the angle to 0, then 90, and watch which way it moves.
emit: 'two_scalars' or 'point' ({ x, y }).

rules.notes: 7 of these across 6 of your presets - the only ResolveFX node in your library.

params.notes: ResolveFX 0.55 and native blur units almost certainly differ - calibrate mul.
If native Shadow takes one point instead of two scalars, set emit to 'point' and give a single target.

rules.notes: The native side is already known from your own Animations/Fade Rotate Blur preset, which Fusion itself wrote: image input 'Input', size 'XBlurSize', and an explicit Filter. The ResolveFX side is unknown - no ResolveFX blur exists anywhere in your library, so Learn Node one in Resolve to get its RegID and input names.
